raw.rationale: This course plan focuses on data engineering and machine learning system development within the AI & Data track. CSC 675 establishes a necessary foundation in database architectures and data management critical for building data pipelines. CSC 665 and CSC 671 provide thorough coverage of foundational and deep learning architectures that ML pipelines support and orchestrate. CSC 603 and CSC 620 deliver applied training in generative AI and language technologies to support state-of-the-art model deployment workflows.

electiveChoices.reason: Provides foundational knowledge of relational and non-relational database design and query execution necessary for data engineering.
Introduces essential artificial intelligence concepts and algorithmic techniques that power ML applications.
Teaches deep neural network architectures and training methods required to build and optimize end-to-end ML pipelines.
Covers applied generative AI modeling and workflows, aligning directly with modern LLM-driven ML engineering.
Covers natural language processing techniques and text processing pipelines essential for working with modern AI models.
